messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur5e-manual, p. 15

3. Your Robot 3. Your Robot 3.1. Copyright © 2009–2025 by Universal Robots A/S. All rights reserved. 21 configurable safety functions. PLd Category 3 in Safety functions accordance with: EN ISO 13849-1. Performance Force Torque sensor accuracy 4N Movement Joints: Max 180 °/s . Speed Maximum TCP speed: Approx. 4 m/s / Approx. 157.5 in/s. Pose repeatability ± 0.03 mm / ± 0.0011 in (1.1 mils) per ISO 9283 Joint ranges ± 360 ° for all joints except Elbow ± 160 ° Features IP classification IP54 Robot Arm: Less than 60 dB(A) Noise Control Box: Less than 50 dB(A) Tool I/O ports 2 digital in, 2 digital out, 2 analog in Tool I/O power supply & voltage 1.5 A (Dual pin) 1 A (Single pin) & 12 V/24 V Physical Footprint Ø151 mm / 5.9 in Materials Aluminium, PC/ASA plastic Robot arm weight 20.7 kg / 45.7 lb User Manual 18 UR5e
